scope: Research snapshot, not a runtime catalog or production import. Original/style-guide, legacy unified, current Universal definitions, selected Revised/Expanded and independent extensions. Not an exhaustive census of all LPC submissions.

conventions.coordinates: zero-based inclusive grid cells; pixel rectangle = [column*frame_width,row*frame_height,frame_width,frame_height]
conventions.frame_counts: Physical source pose columns including idle poses; playback_order contains actual source-column indexes, including repeated holds. Distinct playback counts can differ. Null means unverified/undefined, not an inferred default.
conventions.order: Source-specific definition/inventory serialization only, never a universal priority. Separate files have no common physical order.
conventions.verified: Cited definition and actual local sheet geometry verified. Does not assert every field is known or production rights cleared.
conventions.categories: original = conventional legacy six action families (four verified in base guide, thrust/shoot verified later); extended = explicitly recognized Revised/Expanded/Universal extension; community = independent optional pack. Revision identity is separate from canonical action identity.
conventions.production_use: All assets are research-only and excluded from code-only packaging. A license listing is not a production integration approval.

unresolved: Exact first 2012 publication dates of individual sheets not established; style git history is a 2022 import.
Earlier combined XCF layout not decoded; first verified standalone male body PNG Jan26 2013 is not proof layout originated then.
No normative FPS/durations/loops established for non-walk actions.
Hurt has one visually south-facing row, not four directions.
Six actions are legacy/unified convention, not demonstrated official 2012 contest specification.
Precise six-frame Jump introduction commit unverified
Every per-item/variant license in community archives not audited
No evidence LPCE separate Eliza upstream
Expanded old appended-row map not measured; modern 54-row offsets are not a substitute.
Some custom definitions have no retained item art: candidate entries keep source frame references, not invented physical assets.
Source guide metadata and preview policy are not intrinsic gameplay timing or mandatory loops.

Current project default masculine-thin downstream Emotes has four columns; upstream feminine-thin Emotes here has three. Do not attribute this difference to chronology alone; body/head models differ. scripts/lpc-animations.json is the separate Project preparation manifest; its Emotes/Sitting columns are now individual static poses, not combined clips.
Community inventory is bounded by researched references; not an exhaustive catalog of all independent LPC submissions.
